narrative:
## Handover Summary — Demand & Volume Plan

## Key Decisions
• Floorcare annual volume raised on POS and retail pre-orders
• Spring washing-machine promotion volume added for Europe
• China fridge-freezer volume trimmed for subsidy taper

## Recommendation for Price & Mix
Apply list-price steps and mix shifts on top of these volumes. Focus on North America premium cooking and built-in refrigeration.

signals.title: European Home Appliance Market Outlook
signals.excerpt: European MDA market flat to +1% in 2026 after two years of decline; premium built-in segment recovering faster than freestanding. China competition intensifying in entry price points.
